Container.Name: Feberdin-FoundryVTT
Container.Overview:
Foundry Virtual Tabletop for Unraid using a license-compliant bootstrap image.
This container does not ship Foundry itself. On first start it downloads the official Node.js ZIP from a fresh timed URL generated in your Foundry account, stores the application persistently, and keeps your userdata separate for backups and updates.
Target release families: - Foundry VTT 13.x with Node.js 22 compatibility mode - Foundry VTT 14+ with Node.js 24 compatibility mode
Required first-start input: - FOUNDRY_RELEASE_URL: fresh timed URL from the Foundry website - FOUNDRY_ADMIN_KEY: your setup/admin password
Foundry license key entry still happens inside the Foundry web setup, not through Docker.
Container.BaseImage: debian:bookworm-slim with bundled Node 22 and Node 24 runtimes

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: TCP port used by Foundry inside the container.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent application, cache, logs, and userdata directory.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that should own the files in the mapped AppData path.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that should own the files in the mapped AppData path.

Config.Name: Foundry Timed URL
Config.Description: Required on first install, upgrade, or downgrade. Generate a fresh Node.js timed URL for the exact Foundry version you want. The URL expires after a few minutes.

Config.Name: Foundry Admin Key
Config.Description: Recommended setup/admin password for the Foundry configuration screen.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Bootstrap log verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.

Config.Name: Compatibility Mode
Config.Description: Use auto normally. Set v13 for Foundry 13.351 and other 13.x installs. Set v14 for Foundry 14+.

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Foundry listen port inside the container. Normally leave this at 30000.

Config.Name: Hostname
Config.Description: Optional external hostname used in invitation links when behind a reverse proxy or DNS name.

Config.Name: Route Prefix
Config.Description: Optional URL prefix such as foundry when serving behind a reverse proxy path.

Config.Name: Proxy SSL
Config.Description: Set to true when HTTPS is terminated by a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Proxy Port
Config.Description: Optional external proxy port, usually 443 when using HTTPS.

Config.Name: UPnP
Config.Description: Leave false on Unraid unless you explicitly want UPnP.

Config.Name: Auto World
Config.Description: Optional world ID to auto-launch after Foundry starts.

Config.Name: Reinstall / Downgrade App Files
Config.Description: Set true for repairs, upgrades, or downgrades. Use together with a fresh timed URL for the exact Foundry version you want.

Config.Name: Disable Updates
Config.Description: Optional Foundry startup flag to disable update checks.

Config.Name: Disable IP Discovery
Config.Description: Optional Foundry startup flag for special network setups.
